name: Kumano (Hiroshima, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kumano town emblem in white: an outlined triangle of concentric lines enclosing a small triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Kumano, a town in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1948.

features.role: Kumano town emblem — an outlined triangle of concentric lines enclosing a small triangle
